title: Implement transactional Terraform provider upgrade harness and state-backup verification for shared networking stacks
creator: Ava Moreno
description: Background: Our shared networking Terraform stacks are on a matrix of legacy provider versions across regions and workspaces. Upgrading providers has produced non-idempotent plans, state drift, and occasional resource replacement (EIP/NAT churn) during past rollouts. This ticket implements a repeatable, transactional upgrade harness: safe state backups and verification, a promotion workflow for remote-state copies, and a provider-init + plan-guard that prevents destructive changes unless explicitly approved.
acceptance_criteria: Create automated snapshot of remote state to S3 with immutable timestamped key before any provider upgrade
Implement a promotion workflow: test workspace -> shadow workspace -> production workspace with ability to roll back to snapshot in <30 minutes
Provider-init routine that locks provider versions per-region via pinned provider blocks and validates provider interop matrix before apply
Plan-guard CI job that fails on >0 destructive changes to critical networking resources unless the change is explicitly reviewed and approved
Runbook documented and validated by oncall + infra for upgrade/rollback with a dry-run rehearsal in staging
tasks: Add remote-state snapshot lambda and S3 lifecycle policy (immutable snapshots, 90d retention by default)
Introduce tf wrapper script terraform-upgrade-harness.sh to orchestrate init/plan/apply with pre/post checks
Add provider pin metadata files per-region (providers/azure-us.yaml, providers/aws-eu.yaml) and loader in module root
Create shadow workspaces for prod networking stacks and automated promotion scripts
Implement CI plan-guard job and PR comment bot to show diff and destructive-change counts
Author runbook in Confluence and run a dry-run upgrade in staging with runbook checklist
Add monitoring alert (Datadog) for drift detection and failed promotion attempts
comments: 2025-02-10 - Ava Moreno: Created ticket after Nth outage from NAT replacement during provider upgrade. Initial scope drafted; flagged as P1 given customer-impact risk and historical incidents.

2025-02-14 - Liam Chen: Investigated recent PRs that caused resource replacement. Root cause appears to be provider provider_v3.x implicit schema changes plus mixed provider installations across workspaces. Proposal: pin providers and add a fast remote-state promotion path for verification.
2025-02-18 - Priya Desai (SRE): +1 on snapshots. Suggestion: snapshot should be automatic pre-apply and verification should include a terraform state list sanity check for critical resource IDs.
2025-02-21 - Design Review: Noted that snapshot metadata must include commit SHA and plan hash to tie a state to a code change. Added to tasks.

2025-02-25 - Liam Chen: Prototype terraform-upgrade-harness.sh uploaded in infra repo (branch: feat/upgrade-harness). It performs: terraform init with -plugin-dir, runs plan with -out, counts destroy actions, uploads state snapshot when plan OK. Needs CI gating and PR for provider metadata loader.

2025-02-27 - Code Review (ENG): Feedback from Marco Ruiz: prefer using a checksum-based promotion to avoid accidental overwrite; ensure S3 snapshot is immutable by using object lock or key rotation. Also request unit tests for plan parsing.

2025-03-01 - Liam Chen: Addressed PR comments, added plan parsing tests and switched snapshots to write-once keys (prefix + timestamp + commit). Drafted staging dry-run for 2025-03-05. Marking security_review_required=true and requesting security review link.
2025-03-01 - Security (Olivia Park): Acknowledged; will schedule review. Key items: KMS access audit for snapshot process and IAM least-privilege for promotion script.
